summary_zh: Dodge 開放 670 hp 2027 Charger Daytona EV 訂單，搭載 NACS 端口但價格偏高。

title: BYD 表示其 cast aluminum frame 比鋼鐵更輕、更堅固、更安全
content: If you’re from Pittsburgh, you may want to sit down for this one: global EV sales leader BYD claims the aluminum frame that underpins its new Yangwang U8L SUV passes a brutal, 12 ton lift test – despite weighing over 100 lbs. less than a comparable steel frame. more…
summary_zh: BYD 宣稱其鑄造鋁合金車架比鋼鐵更輕、更堅固且更安全，用於 Yangwang 車款。

title: 這座加州城市正在新增 off-grid solar + storage EV chargers
content: The City of Long Beach, California, is adding six more off-grid solar EV chargers from Beam Global as it continues electrifying its vehicle fleet. more…
summary_zh: 加州 Long Beach 市將新增 6 台 Beam Global 離網太陽能儲能 EV 充電器。

title: Electrify America 正在改變 EV charging 的支付方式
content: Electrify America is changing how EV drivers pay for charging sessions, and it’s ditching one of the more confusing parts of its app in the process. more…
summary_zh: Electrify America 簡化 EV 充電支付流程，移除 App 中較混亂的支付選項。

title: Lectric 剛推出新的 e-bike 公司，可能會撼動 premium market
content: When a new e-bike company launches, it’s usually not a huge deal. The industry sees new brands appear all the time, many of them little more than a logo slapped onto an existing bike from a Chinese catalog. But Monarc isn’t just another startup hoping to make a splash – it’s all but guaranteed to set off a tsunami. more…
summary_zh: Lectric 推出新 e-bike 品牌，預計將以高性價比衝擊 premium 市場。

title: Anker 推出 SOLIX S2000 power station + bundles，從獨家 $598 起
content: We’ve got some exciting Green Deals in our Tuesday edition this week, starting with Anker’s newly launched SOLIX S2000 Portable Power Station + bundles that start from $598 using our exclusive code (beating the standard $680 launch pricing). From there, we also spotted EGO’s Z6 56V 42-inch Cordless Electric Zero Turn Riding Mower with 6x batteries and an 880W wall charger hitting a new $4,499 low
summary_zh: Anker 推出 SOLIX S2000 發電站組合，獨家售價自 598 美元起。

title: Subaru 的新 EVs 已經超越 Solterra 的銷量
content: Just two months after arriving at dealerships, Subaru’s new electric SUVs are outselling the Solterra. more…
summary_zh: Subaru 新款電動 SUV 上市兩個月，銷量已超越 Solterra。

title: Hyundai IONIQ 5 持續熱賣，IONIQ 9 銷量激增近 300%
content: Hyundai’s electric SUV continues winning over buyers after setting another sales record in May. The IONIQ 5 isn’t the only Hyundai EV that saw higher demand last month, with IONIQ 9 sales jumping nearly 300%. more…
summary_zh: Hyundai IONIQ 5 持續熱賣，IONIQ 9 銷量激增近 300%。

title: Mercedes CLA EV 在真實世界測試中達到近 400 miles 的駕駛里程
content: The Mercedes-Benz CLA EV 350 has an EPA-estimated driving range of 312 miles, but in the real world, it drove close to 400 miles on a single charge. more…
summary_zh: Mercedes CLA EV 真實世界單次充電續航近 400 miles，EPA 預估為 312 miles。

title: Tesla Model Y 電池在 16,000 miles 後接受測試：多為 fast charging
content: This Model Y was predominantly fast-charged for six months but its battery remains very healthy.
summary_zh: Tesla Model Y 電池經 16,000 miles 且多為 fast charging 後仍維持健康狀態。

title: Ford 的中國 EREV Bronco 在美國會很受歡迎，但別抱太大期望
content: This rugged plug-in SUV would be great for Americans. But it's made for China and likely won't ever come here.
summary_zh: Ford 中國版 EREV Bronco 適合美國市場，但預計不會引進美國銷售。

title: Tesla 員工洩露對 FSD 的看法：評價不佳
content: On today's episode of the Plugged-In Podcast, we break down Tesla's (troubled) FSD plans and Tim's in-person experience with the Ferrari Luce.
summary_zh: Tesla員工在Podcast中透露FSD計畫遭遇困難且實際體驗不佳。

title: 這款 $199 裝置可為 GM EVs 帶來 Apple CarPlay，但有個缺點
content: Worried about General Motors EVs not having Apple CarPlay? This plug-and-play device seeks to solve that problem.
summary_zh: 199美元裝置可讓GM電動車支援Apple CarPlay，但需插拔使用。

title: Slate 可能在 Carvana 找到強力新夥伴
content: One online car dealer may have quietly secured its place in making Slate's dreams come true, according to a report.
summary_zh: Slate據報可能與Carvana達成合作，助其電動車銷售目標。

title: Amazon 車隊已有超過 50,000 輛 electric delivery vans
content: The American e-commerce giant is halfway toward its goal of 100,000 electric delivery vehicles on the road by 2030.
summary_zh: Amazon已部署超過5萬輛電動送貨車，達成2030年10萬輛目標一半。

title: Volkswagen 將 gas cars 比作馬匹，稱 EVs 明顯更好
content: Horses were never banned, but people realized it’s easier to use gas cars to travel. VW says the same will happen with EVs.
summary_zh: Volkswagen將燃油車比喻為馬匹，強調EVs將全面取代。

title: Audi 全新 Nuvolari Supercar 是 tri-motor plug-in hybrid
content: Audi’s most powerful car ever pairs three tiny axial flux motors with a screaming V-8 engine.
summary_zh: Audi推出Nuvolari三馬達插電式混合超跑，搭載V8引擎。

title: 舊 Waymo 電池將獲得第二次生命，作為 stationary energy storage
content: Waymo struck a deal with B2U Storage Solutions to make sure its old robotaxi batteries live on.
summary_zh: Waymo與B2U合作，將舊robotaxi電池轉為固定式儲能系統。

title: 自駕車的故事比你想像的更早開始
content: Decades before Waymo and Tesla, a Mercedes van used cameras and computers to drive itself down the autobahn.

title: Tesla 希望其 cameras 能像人眼一樣眨眼
content: Computers might be better at some things, but Tesla's newest patent shows that the human eye remains undefeated in one important area.
summary_zh: Tesla申請新專利，讓車用攝影機模擬人眼眨眼功能。

title: 這輛 85% 比例的復古 Bentley 是獨一無二的，而且是電動的
content: The bespoke Bentley Blower Junior was commissioned by American actor Jason Momoa.
summary_zh: Jason Momoa委託打造85%比例電動復古Bentley Blower Junior。

title: Electric trucks 在美國慘敗，Ford 為何再次嘗試
content: Ford says its upcoming electric truck has one job: to be a great vehicle first. The EV part is almost beside the point.
summary_zh: Ford推出新電動卡車，強調先做好車輛本身再談EV特性。

title: Polestar 2 將重返北美市場
content: The fan favorite EV is going back on sale in North America, thanks to Canada’s openness to Chinese-built electric cars.
summary_zh: Polestar 2因加拿大開放中國製電動車，將重返北美銷售。

title: Volvo XC60 Plug-In Hybrid 將大幅提升續航：報告
content: The current XC60 T8 plug-in hybrid can go 35 miles on electric power. The 2028 model will reportedly nearly triple that.
summary_zh: 2028年Volvo XC60 T8插電式混合動力車純電續航將近三倍增至約105英里。

title: 超高里程 EVs 教我們關於 battery degradation 的知識
content: Real-world data and expert battery testing show that even heavily used EVs often lose range gradually rather than suddenly failing.
summary_zh: 真實數據顯示高里程EVs電池續航多緩慢衰退而非突然失效。

title: 為 EV 投保仍然貴很多，但情況正在改變
content: Newer EVs cost about 18% more to insure than gas vehicles. Here's why.
summary_zh: 新款EVs保險費仍比燃油車貴約18%，但差距正逐步縮小。

title: Mercedes CLA EV 在真實世界測試中打破 EPA 續航評級
content: The new Mercedes-Benz CLA 350 4Matic EV blew past its EPA estimate by 73 miles in Edmunds’ real-world range test.
summary_zh: Mercedes-Benz CLA 350 4Matic EV實測續航超出EPA預估73英里。

title: Rivian 的 EV charging network 快速成長，並達成重大里程碑
content: With all the R2 news, it’s easy to forget that Rivian operates its own EV charging network.
summary_zh: Rivian自家EV充電網絡持續擴張並達成重要里程碑。

title: 馬來西亞：Stellantis 開始 Leapmotor C10 的本地組裝
content: Stellantis has started assembling the Leapmotor C10 in Malaysia, aiming to strengthen its presence in the ASEAN region. The mid-size SUV is the brand's first locally built model in the region.
summary_zh: Stellantis在馬來西亞開始組裝Leapmotor C10，強化東南亞布局。

title: BYD 計劃在 Sinopec 加油站安裝其 Flash Chargers
content: BYD has formed a partnership in China with Sinopec to accelerate the expansion of its “Flash Charging” fast-charging network in the country. The move leverages Sinopec’s nationwide footprint of more than 30,000 petrol stations.
summary_zh: BYD與中國石化合作，在加油站部署Flash Charging快充網絡。

title: Audi 推出混合動力超級跑車 Nuvolari
content: Audi has unveiled the Nuvolari, a limited-edition super sports car with a high-performance hybrid drivetrain, restricted to 499 units, combining a V8 biturbo engine with three electric motors and set to become the brand’s most powerful production vehicle with a system output of 736 kW, with deliveries expected to begin in the first half of 2027.
summary_zh: Audi限量499輛Nuvolari插電式混合超跑，搭載V8引擎與三軸向磁通馬達。

title: Nissan 與合作夥伴合作進行硫基固態電池研究
content: Nissan, the University of Oxford and battery material manufacturer Gelion are launching the research project “Cost-effective, Resilient Solid-state Li–S (CoRe-SoLiS)” this month. The project aims to develop a solid-state lithium-sulphur battery with high charging power, energy density and lifespan.
summary_zh: Nissan與牛津大學及Gelion合作開發低成本硫基固態電池。

title: 歐盟汽車套案：公司車輛的電動配額更高？
content: The EU’s car package may not be finalised until 2027, as Members of the European Parliament continue to debate the specifics of the regulations. One of the key issues is the Social Democrats’ demand for a significantly stricter electric vehicle quota for company car fleets than that proposed by the European Commission.

title: B2U 將使用過的 Waymo 電池重新用於二手能源儲存系統
content: Los Angeles-based energy storage manufacturer B2U Storage Solutions has announced a strategic partnership with robotaxi provider Waymo. The aim of the cooperation is to repurpose batteries from Waymo’s electric vehicle fleet after their decommissioning.
summary_zh: B2U Storage Solutions 宣布與 Waymo 策略合作，將使用過的 Waymo 電池用於能源儲存系統。

title: 布拉格啟用擁有 161 個充電點的充電樞紐
content: Prague has transitioned its largest municipal charging hub into regular operation. In the city’s ninth district (Praha 9), up to 161 vehicles can now charge simultaneously at a single location, primarily via AC chargers, but also at Alpitronic Hyperchargers. The charging park is operated by the energy company PRE, in which the city of Prague holds a stake.

title: Foxtron 以自有品牌推出 Cavira 電動 SUV
content: iPhone contract manufacturer Foxconn is launching an electric SUV called Cavira in Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand through its subsidiary Foxtron, with additional markets to follow. After initially positioning Foxtron as a contract manufacturer for Western automakers, the Cavira is now the second production model under its own brand.
summary_zh: Foxconn 旗下 Foxtron 在台灣、澳洲及紐西蘭推出自有品牌 Cavira 電動 SUV。

title: 荷蘭：Lidl 將在 2027 年前為所有 440 家商店配備電動卡車
content: Lidl aims to supply all its stores in the Netherlands with electric trucks starting next year. According to the company, this target will be achieved three years earlier than previously planned. Stores in the North Holland and Flevoland regions are already being supplied entirely by electric transport.
summary_zh: Lidl 計畫 2027 年前為荷蘭 440 家商店全數配備電動卡車，目標明年開始執行。

title: IONCOR Energy Pack：重型電氣化的緊湊電源
content: When electrifying heavy-duty vehicles or off-highway equipment, system integration quickly becomes the deciding factor. Safety, packaging, certification, durability, and lifecycle cost define competitiveness more than the drivetrain itself. This is where IONCOR’s Energy Pack delivers value, offering a compact, high-performance battery platform for space-constrained, reliability-critical applicatio
summary_zh: IONCOR 推出 Energy Pack，針對重型車輛及非公路設備提供緊湊型電源解決方案。

title: MG4 EV Urban 首次駕駛：不刺激，但出奇地好
content: The new MG4 EV Urban makes its mission clear from the name: everyday usability, commuting and straightforward electric mobility. Instead of relying on large displays, exaggerated sportiness or flashy design, MG Motor takes a pragmatic approach. A first drive through urban traffic, along country roads and on the motorway towards Lake Starnberg reveals whether that concept works in practice.
summary_zh: MG4 EV Urban 強調日常通勤實用性，首駕評測顯示表現平穩但舒適。

title: KIA UK 擴展 PV5 產品線，新增 Cargo 和 Passenger 版本
content: KIA UK has announced that a new entry-level Cargo variant and a seven-seat Passenger model will join its roster of PV5 EVs for MY2027. Additional tweaks and improvements have also been introduced for existing models.
summary_zh: KIA UK 宣布 2027 年式 PV5 新增 Cargo 及七人座 Passenger 版本。

title: Moment Energy 在溫哥華開設新的二手設施
content: Canadian company Moment Energy is on the verge of commissioning a facility for repurposing used electric vehicle batteries in stationary battery energy storage systems (BESS). The factory in Vancouver is expected to reach an annual capacity of 1 GWh soon.
summary_zh: Moment Energy 即將在溫哥華啟用二手電動車電池再利用設施，用於固定式儲能。

title: 據報 Samsung SDI 將向 Volkswagen 供應電池芯
content: Volkswagen is reportedly bringing the South Korean battery manufacturer Samsung SDI on board as an additional supplier for its Unified Cell. The standardised battery cell is currently produced by VW subsidiary PowerCo in Salzgitter and by VW affiliate Gotion in China.
summary_zh: Volkswagen 據報將引進 Samsung SDI 作為 Unified Cell 電池芯額外供應商。

title: 愛爾蘭宣布為 EV 報廢計劃提供 1000 萬歐元資金
content: A newly announced scrappage scheme in Ireland aims to help consumers replace aging ICE vehicles with new battery electric vehicles. Applicants could receive up to €5000 in addition to other grants if they agree to scrap an ICE vehicle registered in 2013 or earlier.
summary_zh: 愛爾蘭推出報廢計劃，提供 1000 萬歐元補助消費者以新 EV 汰換老舊燃油車。

title: 英國 EV 市佔率達到 27.3%，為 2019 年以來最強的五月
content: Battery-electric vehicle registrations in the UK continued to accelerate in May, with BEV volumes rising by 34.2% year-on-year to achieve a market share of 27.3%. According to new figures published by the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), the result marks the highest monthly BEV share recorded so far in 2026.
summary_zh: 英國 5 月 BEV 註冊量年增 34.2%，市佔率達 27.3%，創 2019 年來最強五月。

title: Mercedes F1 車隊在歐洲賽季部署 eActros 600
content: The Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team will use a battery-electric Mercedes-Benz eActros 600 for all nine European Formula One races this year. According to the team, this makes it the first Formula One team to use an electric truck throughout an entire European race season.
summary_zh: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 車隊今年歐洲九站 F1 賽事將使用 eActros 600 電動卡車。

title: Xpeng 將在格拉茲的 Magna Steyr 生產第四款車型
content: Chinese EV firm Xpeng is expanding its collaboration with contract manufacturer Magna Steyr. In addition to the G6, G9, and P7+, a fourth model will also be produced at its plant in Graz, as confirmed by Xpeng CEO He Xiaopeng. However, it remains unclear which vehicle this will be.
summary_zh: Xpeng 擴大與 Magna Steyr 合作，除 G6、G9、P7+ 外將在奧地利格拉茲生產第四款車型。

title: Rivian Adventure Network 宣布快速充電里程碑
content: Californian EV startup Rivian has announced that its fast charging network now has more than 1000 DC fast charging ports located across the USA. Four sites featuring a total of 44 charging stalls were opened in the last month alone.
summary_zh: Rivian 快速充電網絡已超過 1000 個 DC 快充埠，遍布美國各地。

title: Sany 在歐洲交付長途電動卡車
content: Sany has started marketing its e263 electric semi-truck in Europe, with the first customer vehicles now operating in Germany. We have all the details about the Chinese electric truck, including payload, net battery capacity and battery warranty. Sany also announced that it will make a ‘big splash with new models and a preview for 2027’ at IAA Transportation.
summary_zh: Sany 開始在歐洲銷售 e263 電動半卡車，首批車輛已在德國投入營運。

title: Nissan 探討在 Sunderland 為 Chery 進行合約製造
content: UK fleet and battery specialist Zenobē and Spanish transport operator Vectalia have signed a framework agreement for a leasing deal worth up to €120 million. The agreement is intended to accelerate the deployment of electric buses and the electrification of depots in Spain.
summary_zh: Nissan 與 Chery 確認正洽談在英國 Sunderland 廠為 Chery 車型進行合約製造。

title: EZO 在英格蘭中部地區獲得 1.76 億英鎊合約
content: Nissan and Chery have officially confirmed that they are negotiating a potential contract manufacturing agreement for Chery passenger vehicles at Nissan's plant in Sunderland, UK. Nissan had previously announced plans to reduce its own production at the factory to a single production line.
summary_zh: EZO 取得 1.76 億英鎊合約，將在英格蘭中部四個議會區部署及營運 EV 充電設施。

title: 印度：Toyota 推出 Urban Cruiser Ebella 作為其首款 EV
content: UK charging provider EZO has secured a £176 million contract to deploy and operate EV charging infrastructure across four Midlands councils. The 15-year project will add 250 rapid and ultra-rapid chargers and support more than two million residents.
summary_zh: Toyota 印度合資公司推出 Urban Cruiser Ebella，作為品牌首款電動車。

title: i-charging 推出適用於汽車和卡車的 500 kW 充電系統
content: Toyota Kirloskar Motor (TKM), the Japanese automaker's joint venture in India, has launched the Urban Cruiser Ebella as its first EV. It is the same zero-emission sub-compact SUV marketed as the Urban Cruiser globally.
summary_zh: i-charging 推出 AiO 500 充電系統，最大輸出功率達 500 kW，適用汽車與卡車。

title: GaN4EmoBiL 展示 800 伏雙向 DC 充電器
content: Portuguese charging infrastructure manufacturer i-charging has introduced its new All-in-One 500 (AiO 500) charging system with up to 500 kW of charging power. The station supports CCS, NACS and GB/T standards, covering the most widely used international charging formats. According to the company, the optional liquid-cooled charging cables also enable regular charging for electric trucks.
summary_zh: GaN4EmoBiL 展示 800 伏雙向 DC 充電器，適用電動車雙向充電應用。

title: 政治人物將盧森堡充電樞紐變成意外的聚會點
content: Seat has announced the start of production for the Volkswagen ID. Polo and the Cupra Raval in Martorell, Spain. For the VW Group, the two compact electric models are among the most important launches of the year. Initially, both vehicles will be built with the larger battery version, while lower-cost variants are set to follow later.

title: Nissan 探討在 Sunderland 為 Chery 進行合約製造
content: Several EU commissioners have reportedly complained that their electric service cars cannot complete the regular trip between Brussels and Strasbourg without stopping to charge at a rest area in Luxembourg. Apparently, the rest area on the 440-kilometer route has now become a frequently used charging spot for politicians.
summary_zh: Nissan 與 Chery 正洽談在英國 Sunderland 廠為 Chery 乘用車進行合約製造。

title: Palmer Energy Technology 收購 Kleandrive
content: As part of the GaN4EmoBiL project, Fraunhofer IAF and Ambibox have developed a power electronic module based on gallium nitride for bidirectional DC charging systems with 800 volts. A demonstrator will be presented next week at the PCIM trade fair in Nuremberg.
summary_zh: Palmer Energy Technology 收購 Kleandrive 業務與資產，聚焦電動巴士重置技術。

title: 印度：Tata Motors 將授權 Chery JLR 的 Freelander 平台
content: UK clean energy and battery technology company Palmer Energy Technology (PETL) has acquired the business and assets of UK electric bus repower specialist Kleandrive through administration. The deal is intended to preserve British engineering capabilities in heavy-duty vehicle electrification and retrofit solutions.
summary_zh: Tata Motors 授權 Chery JLR Freelander 平台，用於印度市場新車開發。

title: NYC 的大型清潔電力線路正式啟用
content: Tata Motors has confirmed plans to license Chery JLR (CJLR)'s new platform, primarily developed for the new Freelander brand. The Indian automaker will use the platform for EVs under its new Avinya brand.
summary_zh: 紐約大型清潔電力線路啟用，強化區域再生能源供應能力。

title: 俄亥俄州阻擋了大量風能和太陽能。其居民付出代價。
content: This analysis and news roundup come from the Canary Media Weekly newsletter. Sign up to get it every Friday. New York City has a lot to celebrate this week. The Knicks are in the finals, the Mets actually won a game, and the city is now a big step closer to meeting its clean energy targets. Tons of clean…

title: 電動汽車開始接管世界
content: Last week, the Ohio Supreme Court blocked a permit for what would be the state’s largest solar installation. The 800-megawatt Oak Run Solar Project still has a pathway to completion — the court reversed only one part of the state siting board’s prior approval — but it remains unclear how things will play out. This…

title: 為什麼北卡羅來納州的電力合作社轉向電網電池
content: This article is part of our ​“Chart of the Week” series . Electric vehicles may be struggling to find buyers in the U.S. — but they’re making inroads elsewhere. A record-breaking 28% of new cars sold this year will be battery-powered, according to new data from the International Energy Agency. That’s a big deal:…

title: 公用事業公司在 PJM 沒有分享智慧電表數據。這是個問題。
content: In July 2022, a fierce summer storm rocked Wake Electric , a North Carolina cooperative serving nearly 60,000 households and other customers from the dense suburbs of Raleigh, the state capital, to rural areas along the Virginia border and in the coastal plain. Wind downed lines and knocked out power for thousands…
summary_zh: PJM 區域公用事業未分享智慧電表數據，影響電網管理效率。

title: 陽台太陽能在您的州處於什麼地位？
content: Utilities have spent nearly $6 billion to install roughly 12 million smart meters at homes and businesses across PJM Interconnection, the biggest U.S. energy market. These devices are meant to help their customers use energy more efficiently and save money. But within much of PJM’s 13-state territory, these devices…

title: 眾議院通過兩黨措施以加速地熱能源項目
content: This article was originally published on April 6, 2026, and last updated on June 4, 2026. Balcony solar is one of the hottest ideas in renewable energy right now. Boosters say the systems — DIY kits that can be plugged right into a standard outlet — save users money without any need for subsidies, government…
